dog.description_text:
Meet Tamara, a distinguished lady with so much love to give!

If you’re looking for your new best friend to be a dog, look no further than Tamara! Tamara loves ferociously, and there is nothing that makes her happier than quality time with her people.

Our favorite thing about Tamara is her loyalty, and how she follows her friends around like their little shadow. While she’s happy to nuzzle your leg for attention, or sit next to you on the couch, her all time favorite spot is in your lap, belly up for pets! She loves to give gentle kisses as a thank you and will follow your hand as you pull away for more cuddles.

Are you ready to snuggle with Tamara? Click the “Adopt Me” button to learn more!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
dog.name: TAMARA
